summary: Royal Bank of Canada filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of $2.3 billion aggregate principal amount of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes under its existing shelf registration. Three tranches were issued: $1B 4.652% notes due 2029, $300M floating-rate notes due 2029, and $1B 4.950% notes due 2032. This is a routine debt takedown with no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change. The filing includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell and Norton Rose Fulbright validating the notes.
